# ----- R UNIVERSE PREP -----

```{r setup}
rm(list = ls()) # remove everything old that might be in my var space
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE) # this is to connect markdown and r - i don't think i need this but whatever
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, nlme, CorrMixed, lme4, lmerTest, geepack, ggplot2, geomtextpath, car, emmeans, effectsize, simr, matrixStats, haven) # pacman is a package manager for R (!!! useful). Install packages if missing and load them 
options(scipen=999) # strongly avoid scientific notations (none of the e bs)
```

# ----- LOAD DATA -----

```{r data}

data_eo <- read.table("/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new/rr_data/EO_relpower_behavbl.csv", header=T, sep=",")
data_ec <- read.table("/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new/rr_data/EC_relpower_behavbl.csv", header=T, sep=",")

plots_dir = '/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new/rr_plots/'

data_eo$Drug <- factor(data_eo$Drug)
data_eo$TP <- factor(data_eo$TP)
data_eo$id <- factor(data_eo$id)

data_ec$Drug <- factor(data_ec$Drug)
data_ec$TP <- factor(data_ec$TP)
data_ec$id <- factor(data_ec$id)

# add scaling???

# SPLIT DATA between ot and pl

data_eo_ot_all<-data_eo[data_eo$Drug==1,]
data_eo_pl_all<-data_eo[data_eo$Drug==2,]

data_ec_ot_all<-data_ec[data_ec$Drug==1,]
data_ec_pl_all<-data_ec[data_ec$Drug==2,]
```

# ===================================================
# ---------------- MAIN MODELS - EO -----------------
# ===================================================

# -----> EO - Theta <-------

```{r eo-theta}

#THETA

t <- lmer(Theta ~ Theta_base + TP * Drug + (1 | id),data = data_eo)
a <- anova(t, type = 3)
print(a)

```
```{r eo-theta-p}

# do pairwise comparisons
emm_t = emmeans(t, specs = pairwise ~ Drug|TP, type = "response", adjust = "none")
emm_t
```
```{r eo-theta-t}

# TPs with sig
d1 = t_to_d(t = 3.223,df = 190)
d2 = t_to_d(t = 2.792,df = 190)
d3 = t_to_d(t = 2.318,df = 190)
d4 = t_to_d(t = 1.877,df = 190)
d5 = t_to_d(t = 2.415,df = 190)
d6 = t_to_d(t = 2.856,df = 190)

print('TP1:')
print(d1)
print('TP2:')
print(d2)
print('TP3:')
print(d3)
print('TP4:')
print(d4)
print('TP5:')
print(d5)
print('TP6:')
print(d6)
```

```{r eo-theta-plot}

p <- ggplot(data_eo, aes(x = factor(TP), y = Theta,
                    color = factor(Drug), group = Drug)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red"),
    labels = c("Oxytocin", "Placebo")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(1:6)) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Relative Power of Theta",
    color = "Drug"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15)
  )

ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "plot_relpower_theta_eo.png"),
       plot = p,
       width = 8, height = 6,
       units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r eo-alpha}
print(a)
```
